content: The intervention studied by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) in the ADVANCE trial demonstrated a 9% reduction in the risk of the primary composite endpoint, which included both macrovascular and microvascular events. Additionally, the intervention was associated with a 14% reduction in mortality from any cause and an 18% reduction in cardiovascular-related mortality. A follow-up period of seven years revealed that the risk reduction achieved in the intervention group was sustained over time.
